picks.editorial_note: A combined $1B+ commitment from Georgia Tech and Emory is one of the largest single-week AI investments in the dataset, aimed at building a leading AI hub and driving statewide economic growth.
picks.title: Georgia Tech and Emory Invest More Than $1B in AI to Drive State’s Jobs, Economic Growth

picks.editorial_note: A White House-announced 15-university, 10-state consortium to pool supercomputing resources signals federal-level strategic coordination of academic AI infrastructure, not just a single-campus initiative.
picks.title: UK partners with regional universities in super intelligence computing consortium

picks.editorial_note: SLAC leading a DOE Genesis Mission project to apply autonomous AI-driven discovery to catalysis research could accelerate breakthroughs in energy and chemical science well beyond a single lab.
picks.title: SLAC to lead a Department of Energy Genesis Mission project for Super Intelligence (SI)-driven autonomous discovery in catalysis

picks.editorial_note: Phase II DOE funding for Berkeley Lab's MOAT-Core project shows sustained federal commitment to AI-driven design of particle accelerators, a capability with broad implications for physics infrastructure.
picks.title: Super Intelligence for Particle Accelerators Gets Another Boost

picks.editorial_note: SLAC's SPIRE project to build autonomous 'self-driving laboratories' represents a genuine shift in how experimental science could be conducted, with AI agents and robots running experiments with minimal human intervention.
picks.title: SLAC leads new project to build the self-driving laboratory of the future

picks.editorial_note: Fermilab's two new Genesis Mission awards extend DOE's AI push into microelectronics and quantum information science, areas critical to the next generation of computing hardware.
picks.title: Fermilab to lead two new Genesis Mission awards to accelerate development of microelectronics and quantum

picks.editorial_note: Georgia Tech's $20M NSF-funded Nexus supercomputer, opened nationwide and built with University of Illinois, expands shared access to high-performance AI computing for researchers beyond its own campus.
picks.title: Georgia Tech Opens Supercomputer to Researchers Nationwide

picks.editorial_note: A $30M NSF center spanning UT Austin, MIT, Tufts, Utah, Yale, and Indiana to study human-robot co-adaptation represents a substantial, multi-institution bet on foundational robotics research.
picks.title: Luddy researchers join new $30 million NSF Center to shape the future of human-robot co-adaptation

picks.editorial_note: A CWRU alumnus's optical computing startup targets AI's biggest infrastructure bottleneck — energy consumption — with a novel light-based chip approach that could have real-world impact on data center costs.
picks.title: A CWRU entrepreneur studied invisibility cloaks. Now he’s working to cut AI’s energy use | CWRU Newsroom | Case Western Reserve University

picks.editorial_note: An R&D 100 Award — one of the field's most recognized innovation prizes — for LANL-led AI-enhanced facility monitoring validates a genuinely novel safety and security application of AI.
picks.title: NNSS collaborates on LANL's R&D 100 Award-winning Persistent DynAMICS project - Nevada National Security Site
